[[File:Animated Pokédex logo.png|thumb|Logo]] '''Animated Pokédex''' (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモン{{ruby|動画図鑑|どうがずかん}}}}''' ''{{tt|Pokémon Video Encyclopedia|Video Pokédex}}'', Simplified Chinese: '''{{lang|zh-cmn-Hans-CN|宝可梦动画图鉴}}''' ''{{tt|Pokémon Animated Encyclopedia|Animated Pokédex}}'') is a series of {{pkmn|animation|animated}} shorts produced by several animation studios in {{pmin|mainland China}}. The first short "Eevee" (伊布篇) was released on Weibo, Douyin, and Bilibili in mainland China on April 29, 2024, along with an announcement that additional shorts would be released during the rest of 2024. The short was subsequently released on official Japanese and English social media accounts in May and June 2024. The first season "Island Break" (小憩岛中) was produced by Tianjin Niceboat Culture Communication Co., Ltd. (好传动画). Episodes were released every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10:00 AM (UTC+8) from August 5 to 26, 2024.[https://weibo.com/6305628151/OqnlujyRL Announcement of Season 1 on Weibo] These shorts were subsequently released on the official Traditional Chinese and Indonesian Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels from October 14 to November 18, 2024, on the English [[Pokémon Kids TV]] channel as a "compilation of Season 2" on January 3, 2025, on the South Asian channels from January 13 to March 17, 2025, on the official Japanese channel from January 20 to 31, 2025, on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV channel as a "compilation of Season 2" on January 31, 2025, on the Pokémon Asia ENG channel from March 10 to April 10, 2025, on the official English, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese YouTube channels and social media accounts from June 24 to July 24, 2025, and on the official French, German, Italian, and Spanish YouTube channels and social media accounts from July 29 to September 30, 2025. The second season "Wholly Witty" (千伶百俐) was produced by Shanghai Witzone Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海智间网络). Episodes were released every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10:00 AM (UTC+8) from November 27 to December 16, 2024.[https://weibo.com/6305628151/P1U2h7FBY Announcement of Season 2 on Weibo]Due to the observance of {{wp|Nanjing Massacre Memorial Day}} on Friday, December 13, the episode was instead released one day earlier on Thursday, December 12. These shorts (along with the first short "Eevee") were subsequently released on the official Japanese YouTube channel from December 16 to 27, 2024, on the Japanese Pokémon Kids TV channel as a "compilation of Season 1" on January 3, 2025, on the English Pokémon Kids TV channel as a "compilation of Season 1" on January 31, 2025, on the official English, Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese YouTube channels and social media accounts from May 13 to June 17, 2025, on the official French, German, Italian, and Spanish YouTube channels and social media accounts from June 1 to July 17 and October 30 to November 5, 2025, on the official Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, and Pokémon Asia ENG YouTube channels from August 1 to October 3, 2025, and on the South Asian channels beginning November 25, 2025. The third season "Summer Frolic" (嬉闹一夏) was produced by Beijing FENZ Interactive Culture & Communication Co., Ltd. (分子互动文化传播有限公司). The first two episodes were released on July 18 and 19, 2025, with the remaining eight episodes released every weekday at 17:00 PM (UTC+8) from September 8 to 17, 2025.[https://weibo.com/6305628151/PBGds0teB Announcement of Season 3 on Weibo] These shorts were subsequently released on the official Japanese YouTube channel from October 6 to 17, 2025, and on the Japanese and English Pokémon Kids TV channels as a "compilation of Season 3" on November 14, 2025. The fourth season "Vibrant Moment" (转瞬缤纷) was produced by B&T Animation (Beijing) Culture Co., Ltd. (彼岸天（北京）网络科技有限公司). The first five episodes were released every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 5:00 PM (UTC+8) from January 19 to 28, 2026[https://weibo.com/6305628151/5256845934730548 Release of Season 4 on Weibo] with the remaining episodes released every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 5:00 PM (UTC+8) from March 9 to 16, 2026.
